title: Housekeeping Directory Migration and rdd-conform Scope Extension
summary: Specifies the mechanical migration of `docs/housekeeping/audits/` and `docs/housekeeping/cycle-status.md` into the housekeeping directory structure that ADR-064 committed to but deferred, creates `docs/housekeeping/gates/` for ADR-066's gate reflection notes, and updates path references across ADRs, essays, skill files, the ADR-063 manifest, the domain model, and ORIENTATION. The migration is a one-shot, idempotent operation triggered by `/rdd-conform migrate`, writing a `.migration-version` marker file that the Stop hook (ADR-064) reads to distinguish advisory mode (pre-migration) from enforcement mode (migrated). `rdd-conform` gains three new audit scopes: housekeeping directory organization, gate reflection note template alignment, and dispatch prompt format.
workflow_point: one-shot migration via /rdd-conform migrate, run at a phase boundary or between cycles
mechanism: one-shot idempotent corpus migration with version marker, plus three new rdd-conform audit scopes

supersession.text: ADR-085 relocates infrastructure artifacts from `docs/housekeeping/` to `.rdd/` and applies process-vs-product directory separation via the dotfile convention. ADR-070's centered-vs-infrastructure framing remains current; only the placement changes.

links.note: ADR-085 relocates infrastructure artifacts from `docs/housekeeping/` to `.rdd/` and applies process-vs-product directory separation via the dotfile convention. ADR-070's centered-vs-infrastructure framing remains current; only the placement changes.
Updates every `path_template` value in ADR-063's manifest to the post-migration housekeeping paths.
Executes the housekeeping-directory migration (audits and cycle-status) that ADR-064 committed to but explicitly deferred to this ADR.

Coordinates with ADR-065: the migration updates the canonical `Output path:` values in skill-file dispatch prompts in lockstep with the manifest's path_template updates, so skill text and hook manifest do not disagree mid-transition.
Creates `docs/housekeeping/gates/` as required by ADR-066's gate reflection notes; unlike audits and cycle-status, this location has no pre-migration equivalent and is created rather than migrated.
